source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 16ης Μαΐου — «Όσιοι Κασσιανός και Λαυρέντιος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 16 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, whose one line names two venerable men and whose page carries two head names and two dates — an enumerated pair, and so one folder each. **He is none of the corpus's nine Laurences**: the page makes him a disciple of Cornelius of Komel, elected abbot of that monastery in 1538 on Cornelius's own recommendation, and a copier of church books, and nothing in the corpus answers to that. **`abbot` is in `types` on the page's own word**, «ομοφώνως εξελέγη ηγούμενος από τους αδελφούς της μονής». **Cornelius of Komel has no folder** and is named without a link. **No hymn, no birthplace, no parents, no relics.**
